exports_csv_note.source: Ernie原生毫米坐标；保留原电极顺序与区域编号。
exports_csv_note.en: Ernie native coordinates in millimetres; original electrode order and region indices.

exports_design_note.source: 仅布局坐标与区域标签，可用于本App的坐标导入。
exports_design_note.en: Layout coordinates and region labels for this app's coordinate importer.

exports_raw_note.source: 原始保存记录，包括指标、坐标和来源字段。
exports_raw_note.en: The original saved record, including metrics, coordinates and provenance.

exports_report_note.source: 当前指标、最低保留要求和模型来源，适合阅读与分享。
exports_report_note.en: Current metrics, minimum retention requirement and model provenance, formatted for reading and sharing.

exports_bundle_note.source: 读取原始配置、轨迹与校验身份；不包含代码、头模或前向矩阵文件。
exports_bundle_note.en: Reads the original configuration, trace and integrity metadata; code, head meshes and forward-matrix files are not included.

exports_note.source: 导出只读取已有结果，不启动仿真。布局JSON与结果JSON用途不同。
exports_note.en: Exports only read saved results and never start a simulation. Layout JSON and result JSON serve different purposes.

exports_no_layout.source: 没有已完成的布局坐标；仍可导出保存记录与报告。
exports_no_layout.en: No completed layout coordinates are available. The saved record and report can still be exported.

exports_bad_design.source: 坐标或区域分配不符合当前64电极导入格式；请使用完整结果JSON保留原数据。
exports_bad_design.en: Coordinates or region allocation do not match the current 64-electrode import format. Use full result JSON to preserve the original data.

exports_prepared.source: 文件已准备下载，可在浏览器下载列表中查看。
exports_prepared.en: The file is ready for download. Check your browser's downloads list.

exports_failed.en: Export did not complete. Try again.

exports_bundle_failed.source: 复现实验包读取失败，请重试。
exports_bundle_failed.en: Unable to read the reproducibility bundle. Try again.

exports_bundle_mismatch.source: 返回的实验包与当前方案不匹配，未导出文件。
exports_bundle_mismatch.en: The returned experiment bundle does not match the current layout. No file was exported.

exports_invalid_id.source: 记录编号格式无效，无法读取复现实验包。
exports_invalid_id.en: The record ID is invalid, so the reproducibility bundle cannot be read.

exports_report_title.source: EEG Layout Lab · 方案结果摘要
exports_report_title.en: EEG Layout Lab · Layout result summary

exports_report_basis.source: 本报告读取已保存的指标；没有重新评价、重新优化或更改原始记录。
exports_report_basis.en: This report reads saved metrics. It does not re-evaluate, re-optimize or change the original record.

exports_geometry.source: 保存的布局与空间约束

exports_frame_value.source: Ernie原生坐标，单位mm；区域编号从0开始，电极顺序不变。
exports_frame_value.en: Ernie native coordinates in mm; zero-based region indices and unchanged electrode order.

exports_region_area.source: 保存的实际区域并集面积

exports_requirement.source: 本次报告的最低保留要求
exports_requirement.en: Minimum retention requirement for this report

exports_rule.source: 判据：场重建、最差10%源幅度、定位效用三项保留率均达到此要求。改变要求只改变判定，不改变保存分数。
exports_rule.en: Criterion: field reconstruction, lower-10% source amplitude and localization utility retention must each meet this requirement. Changing the requirement changes the assessment, not the saved scores.

exports_field.source: 场重建保留率（相对标准64导）

exports_sensitivity.source: 最差10%源幅度保留率（相对标准64导）
exports_sensitivity.en: Lower-10% source amplitude retention (relative to standard 64)

exports_localization.source: 定位效用保留率（相对标准64导）

exports_absolute.source: 当前布局的绝对重建解释率
exports_absolute.en: Current layout's absolute reconstruction explained energy

exports_baseline_absolute.source: 标准64导的绝对重建解释率

exports_median.source: 当前布局定位误差中位数

exports_baseline_median.source: 标准64导定位误差中位数

exports_pass.en: All three metrics meet the requirement

exports_fail.en: At least one metric is below the requirement

exports_metric_scope.source: 三项分别比较重建解释能量、幅度下尾和定位误差效用，不是统一的准确率；标准64导的100%是相对基准。
exports_metric_scope.en: The three metrics compare explained reconstruction energy, lower-tail amplitude and localization-error utility. They are not a unified accuracy measure; standard 64's 100% is a relative baseline.

exports_provenance_note.source: 以下来源字段按保存记录原样输出；未记录的头模、源数、噪声或版本参数不补写。
exports_provenance_note.en: The provenance fields below are reproduced from the saved record. Unrecorded head-model, source-count, noise or version parameters are not inferred.

exports_coordinate_history_scope.source: 这条记录评价固定的64点坐标，没有执行布局搜索。实验包分别保存输入坐标和实际评价坐标，并保留原始指标。
exports_coordinate_history_scope.en: This record evaluates a fixed set of 64 coordinates without searching for a layout. The bundle keeps the input and evaluated coordinates separate and preserves the saved metrics.

exports_coordinate_bundle_scope.source: 实验包包含坐标评价请求、评价结果和校验身份；重新计算需要对应版本代码及头模/前向库文件。
exports_coordinate_bundle_scope.en: The bundle contains the coordinate evaluation request, result and integrity metadata. Recalculation requires the corresponding code version, head model and forward-library files.

exports_coordinate_bad_cache.source: 坐标评价缓存校验失败
exports_coordinate_bad_cache.en: The coordinate evaluation cache failed its integrity check

exports_coordinate_bad_identity.source: 坐标评价记录身份不匹配
exports_coordinate_bad_identity.en: The coordinate evaluation record identity does not match

exports_coordinate_bad_record.source: 坐标评价来源与所选记录不匹配
exports_coordinate_bad_record.en: The coordinate evaluation source does not match the selected record

exports_coordinate_bad_source.source: 坐标评价来源路径或身份无效
exports_coordinate_bad_source.en: The coordinate evaluation source path or identity is invalid
